title: How to hide or delete a Periscope broadcast
description: You can hide broadcasts so only you can see them, or delete them entirely from your account. Use your broadcast's info panel to manage these settings.

toc.title: How to hide or delete a Periscope broadcast

runs: On March 31, 2021, Periscope and the Super Broadcaster program was shut down. Soon, we’re making further changes to the broadcasts we store. If you have broadcasts recorded through >x< or Periscope, we encourage you to download them. Read more
You can hide a broadcast on iOS and Android, so only you can see it, by visiting your broadcast’s info panel and tapping
. When your broadcast is hidden it will have a
icon in the upper left corner of the broadcast thumbnail on Android, and in the middle of the thumbnail on iOS.
You can always unhide your broadcast by revisiting the info panel and selecting
. When you unhide a public broadcast, it will be visible to everyone. For private broadcasts, unhidden broadcasts will only be visible to invited viewers.
If you earned stars in a broadcast, you will not lose the star balance you accrued when you hide it.
